name: Promenade Temecula
summary: Chain known for unique gadgets, gifts & lifestyle items, such as electronics & travel accessories.
description: Promenade Temecula is your premier shopping destination in Temecula, California, offering an exciting lineup of the best brands in the market along with a variety of dining options and entertainment experiences. The mall features a diverse mix of retailers, a movie theater (Regal Edwards with IMAX), and engaging family-friendly events throughout the year. Whether you're seeking retail therapy, delicious meals, or memorable experiences, Promenade Temecula delivers a complete shopping and entertainment experience.
demographics: Promenade Temecula serves the rapidly growing Temecula Valley and surrounding Riverside County communities, attracting predominantly middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000. The primary visitor base consists of millennials and Gen X families with children, as well as active retirees drawn to the region's suburban lifestyle and wine country appeal. Shoppers typically seek a blend of value-oriented and mid-tier national brands with convenient access to dining and entertainment, reflecting the area's family-focused, lifestyle-oriented demographic that values experiential shopping combined with leisure activities.
